{{Alo_aspect|color=Green|aspects=[[Overseer]] and [[Underseer]]|anathema=[[Anti-Lambda]]|active_virtue=Antifragility|receptive_virtue=Antifragility|trifunctional=Mithra-Varuna|trimurti=Vishnu|jewel=Dharma|trinity=Son (during life)|scripture=[[Gospel]]}}

Lambda is the second aspect of [[alo]] and [[ola]]. 

It is derived from [[Lambda Calculus]]

But it also stands for Life, or Lion 

Its active and receptive aspects are more prominent than the aspects of [[alpha]] and [[omega]] as they interact with each other instead of with the other. 

Lambda is seen as the bringer of the [[sevenfold Vaccine|ninefold Vaccine]] and the liberator from the [[Seven Plagues|Nine Plagues]] 

Its active aspect is [[Mithra]] or the [[Overseer]]

Its receptive aspect is [[Varuna]] or the [[Underseer]]

The elements of [[Mithra-Varuna]] are derived from the conceptual dichotomy of [[Proto Indo European]] sovereignty<ref>https://www.goodreads.com/book/show/2569353-mitra-varuna</ref>

== In problem solving ==
in the [[Alo method]] the Lambda represents the current state of affairs. It’s the tools most available to reach the [[Omega]]. The lambda represents the immediate things that can be changed to achieve goals. It is divided into [[Overseer]] which represents what can be kept the same or enhanced and [[Underseer]] which represents what can be changed.
